title: Selection of appropriate solvent additives for the preparation of high-performance Cs2AgBiBr6 solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01404B, Paper
Lun Zhang, Chengyang Wang, Ziying Wen, Mei Lyu, Jun Zhu
Lewis bases, DMPU, MeIm, and EDA were introduced into the Cs2AgBiBr6 precursor solution as solvent additives. MeIm with moderate DN resulted in dense and uniform Cs2AgBiBr6 films and the corresponding solar cells delivered a PCE of 2.61%.
